This seems to be about "the upbringing of eternal learners" or "the training of those taught from eternity." The second part says "they did not solve the difficulty of this task." Option 2: "افتادگی آموز اگر طالب فیضی - هرگز نخورد آب زمینی که بلند است"
This translates to: "Learn humility if you seek beneficence - the water never reaches the ground that is high." This is clearly about humility: one must be lowly/modest to receive blessings. The metaphor is that water flows down to low places, not high ones. So the concept is about humility being necessary for receiving spiritual gifts.

Option 3: "به ذره تربیتش کار آفتاب آموخت - به مور تقویتش قدرت سلیمان داد"
This means: "To an atom, its upbringing taught the work of the sun; to an ant, its strengthening gave the power of Solomon." This is about how proper upbringing/training can bring out extraordinary potential in even the smallest creatures. The concept is about the transformative power of education/upbringing.

This translates to: "Weeping of evening and dawn, thanks that it was not wasted - our raindrop became a single pearl." This is about how tears/suffering (weeping) is not wasted and can be transformed into something precious (a pearl).
